scope: All three Baltic direct-input matrices through enhanced BIOS and DOS on HIGH/UMB and LOW; within-layout grouped composition and hotkeys; explicit IDs/alias, reloads, rejected selections and bad/missing header preservation. Deep library validation and pending-state mode/reload boundaries are separate open gates.

machine.profile_proof: Guest HMA and UMB checks for HIGH; conventional DOS placement for LOW. Successful cases require profile markers before and after input; negative controls require the initial marker.

library_change.rationale: ID lookup starts at the first 454 directory entry. Its group must include both ET and EE for explicit EE /ID:454. Translation logic, common sections and page data remain byte-identical.

retention: Identical ordered physical-input oracles are retained once and referenced by hash. Source report hashes identify the private raw reports; all case metadata, input oracles, serial logs, startup files and final compiled expected includes are retained here. For multi-program phases, expected.bin is the last phase; layout_phases retains every phase command and oracle.
probe_compatibility: Default BIOS, enhanced BIOS and DOS probe binaries were assembled from HEAD and the new source against identical expected data and compared byte-identical. GROUPED_INPUT is opt-in.
remaining: Pending dead-key state across US/national selection, successful/rejected KEYB reloads and country/codepage switches.
Additional modifier/fallback/hardware-specific edges and deeply malformed section/directory/logic/page data, preserving resident state after rejection.
Supported AT-84/XT-83 and other real-BIOS keyboard/country/font qualification.
Installed pack, recipes/notices, physical COMMAND/EDLIN and national filename workflows, artifact coverage and full BALTIC.md release gates.
